common._notes: crf 0.0944 = 7 %/y over 20 y (Enterprise Products PDH, EPA GHG permit application 2012). gas 2.5 USD/GJ = 2.60 USD/MMBtu paid by the PetroLogistics Catofin plant (SEC 424B4, 2012); Henry Hub 2024 2.19 USD/MMBtu (EIA). fixed O&M 4 %/y of capex, power 0.08 USD/kWh, metal recovery 0.95 and financing 0.08/y: assumptions as in the NH3/methanol chains.

thermo._note: van 't Hoff fit to equilibrium conversion of pure propane at 1 bar: 0.32 (550 C), 0.50 (600 C), 0.68 (650 C)

_sources.propane_usd_t: EIA Mont Belvieu propane spot 2024 0.778 USD/gal at 4.2 lb/gal = 408 USD/t
_sources.reference X, S: Oleflex: 86 % selectivity at 40 % single-pass conversion (Dong, Altvater, Mark, Hermans, OSTI 1866245, p17); propane use 1.2 lb per lb propylene (PetroLogistics SEC 424B4 2012) = S 0.873
_sources.reference T: Oleflex 525-705 C, 1-3 bar (Moffat PhD thesis, Glasgow 2023, p5); 640 C and 1.5 bar chosen inside that window
_sources.h2_ratio: assumption (not found in an open source)
_sources.t_cycle_h: Oleflex CCR cycle 5-8 days (Dong et al. p17): 6.5 d
_sources.catalyst_life_y: reactor catalyst replaced about every three years (PetroLogistics SEC 424B4)
_sources.capex: 1.30 bn USD (Dec 2012) for 1.654 bn lb/y = 750 kt/y, annualised at 7 %, 20 y (Enterprise Products PDH, EPA GHG permit application)
_sources.e_proc_GJ_per_t_feed: calibrated so that the reference plant buys 17.5 GJ natural gas per t propylene after burning its own H2 and light ends (PetroLogistics: 9.96 M MMBtu for ~601 kt propylene)
_sources.power_kWh_per_t_feed: calibrated to PetroLogistics fuel + utilities 35.4 M USD/y minus gas 25.9 M USD/y = ~16 USD/t propylene at 0.08 USD/kWh
_sources.reference r, Pt 0.3 wt%, Sn 0.3 wt%: assumption (Oleflex Pt loading not in an open source; '<1 wt%' search summary only)

_sources.plant: 2-5 adiabatic stages with intercooling, 200-550 C, 20 bar reference case; >= 98 % CO2 conversion needs <300 C at 20 bar in the last stage (Goetz et al., Renew. Energy 85 (2016) 1371)
_sources.capex: 175 EUR/kW_SNG (Goetz 2016, consistent with Outotec; range 130 EUR/kW at 110 MW to 400 EUR/kW at 5 MW) x 1.33 USD/EUR (2014) x 96.4 MW_SNG (50 kt/y CH4 at 8000 h, HHV)
_sources.reference r: GHSV 3500 h-1 inside the 2000-5000 h-1 of technical adiabatic fixed beds (Goetz Table 4), 20 % CO2 in the feed, bed density 1.0 kg/L (assumption), X 0.80 -> 0.40 kg CH4/kg/h
_sources.h2_usd_kg: 3 USD/kg: the anchor of Becker, Penev & Braun, J. Energy Resour. Technol. 2019 (132 USD/MWh SNG); grey ~2, electrolytic 5-7 (DOE Liftoff 2024)
_sources.co2_usd_t: 104 USD/t CO2 captured (Enterprise Products EPA application 2012) rounded to 100
